notes.title: Latest Update Notes
notes.content: The game's second long CG show plays the change. Players need to press the E key to play, and at the same time solve the problem of characters walking around at will.

notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
The game update is as follows
1. Updated the direction of the double door, the player enters and opens inward; the player exits and opens outward. No longer blocks players.
2. Added the camera shaking effect when the player shoots.
3. Added a little AI in the lobby of the office area.
4. Increased ambient brightness.ːcozybethesdaː

notes.title: Remove a bug
notes.content:
1. Fix the game pause bug caused by double-push doors on the first floor of the safe house.
2. Each gun doubles the amount of ammunition.
